title: Bourgelon - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Bourgelon in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Bourgelon is a light-element weapon used by Sciel. It scales with Agility (C), Vitality (B).

sections.title: How to Get the Bourgelon
sections.content:
Location: Coastal Cave merchant.

Obtained from Coastal Cave merchant.

sections.title: Is the Bourgelon Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (C), Vitality (B). A dedicated light pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
